name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual NDA allowing two parties to share confidential information for evaluating a potential business relationship.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template to be paired with the Mutual NDA Standard Terms, containing the party-specific details and any modifications.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for cloud-based SaaS products covering access rights, payment, data privacy, security, liability, and indemnification.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard agreement for design partner programs giving early product access in exchange for structured feedback to help develop the product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA addendum defining uptime targets, response time commitments, service credits, and remedies for cloud service agreements.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for professional and consulting services engagements covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, and indemnification.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard DPA for GDPR-compliant data processing covering processor obligations, subprocessors, restricted transfers, and security incidents.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for on-premise software licensing covering installation rights, restrictions, updates, warranty, and support.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard partnership agreement covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification between two companies.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard agreement for time-limited product pilots and evaluations, allowing customers to test a product before committing to a full agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard BAA for HIPAA-compliant handling of protected health information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum governing AI/ML service terms including input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
